title: CLI & Linux Intro
task:
Make two reports beside docs/ in the workspace root. Leave the two starter files in docs/ in place.

1. Save the contents of docs/welcome.txt as welcome-copy.txt.
2. Save the sorted names inside docs/ to docs-list.txt, one name per line and no directory prefixes.
hints: Look for lab/ in the prompt. If it shows lab/docs, run cd .. to return. Use pwd and ls docs to inspect the lab without moving.
While at lab/, run cat docs/welcome.txt > welcome-copy.txt. Then run cat welcome-copy.txt to confirm the contents.
While at lab/, run LC_ALL=C ls -1 docs > docs-list.txt. Check that it lists checklist.txt and welcome.txt, then run cli-silly check.

checks.label: The welcome note was copied intact
checks.feedback: From lab/, read docs/welcome.txt and redirect its output to welcome-copy.txt.

checks.label: The docs listing has one sorted name per line
checks.feedback: From lab/, list docs/ with one name per line. Check that it includes both original starter filenames.

demo.explanation: pwd shows the root directory. ls notes reads the names in notes/ while you stay where you are.
The input is inside notes/. The output goes beside notes/ because the relative output path starts at your current directory.
Read the report to see what was written. The previous redirection sent the output to the file, so it did not appear in the terminal.
